data.title: 拉·芙利亚 · 宫廷舞厅的祖母绿露背晚礼服
data.description: 王宫镜厅晚宴落幕时分，辉煌的水晶吊灯下余香未散。拉·芙利亚身穿一袭极具奢华质感的祖母绿无袖露背丝绒晚礼服，白皙无瑕的整个美背如凝脂般诱人。她手挽晚宴手包在光洁如镜的大理石地面上轻盈回旋，银发如瀑布飞扬，在万众瞩目的璀璨宫廷中，眼波流转只锁定你一人的身影。
data.action: twirling gracefully on marble ballroom floor, luxurious backless emerald velvet gown, silver hair splayed in motion, glowing chandelier lighting, captivating royal gaze
data.location: hall of mirrors ballroom with gilded baroque architecture and crystal chandeliers
data.lighting: brilliant golden chandelier luminescence reflecting on polished marble floor
data.mood: opulent aristocratic splendor, intoxicating courtly seduction
data.promptProse: Spinning with graceful poise across a marble palace ballroom, La Folia wears an emerald velvet backless gown. Her flowing silver hair catches the chandelier light as she turns with captivating, royal elegance.
data.animaCaption: La Folia dancing in an emerald backless velvet gown in a grand palace ballroom.
